name: sh.oec/mcp-server
title: oec.sh
description: Operate your oec.sh Odoo servers, projects and environments with your own API key.

environmentVariables.name: OECSH_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your oec.sh API key (oec_live_ro_... read only, or oec_live_rw_... full access), from Settings > API Keys.

environmentVariables.name: OECSH_ALLOW
environmentVariables.description: Opt-in tools, comma separated: destructive, backup-download. Empty by default.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by your oec.sh API key, e.g. Bearer oec_live_ro_...
